author: nickyeow

english.text: Walking along the street, I met an old friend.

jyutping: ngo5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 zong6 dou3 go3 gau6 pang4 jau5。
text: 我喺街度撞到個舊朋友。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I hear that his father is in another country.

jyutping: teng1 gong2 keoi5 lou5 dau6 heoi3 zo2 ngoi6 gwok3 wo3。
text: 聽講佢老豆去咗外國喎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't let the cops find a heater on you.

jyutping: m4 hou2 bei2 di1 caai1 lou2 faat3 jin6 nei5 jau5 coeng1 hai2 san1。
text: 唔好俾啲差佬發現你有槍喺身。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He likes coffee without sugar.

jyutping: keoi5 jam2 gaa3 fe1 m4 zung1 ji3 lok6 tong4。
text: 佢飲咖啡唔鍾意落糖。

author: nickyeow

english.text: This table is just as large as ours.

jyutping: nei1 zoeng1 toi2 tung4 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 go2 zoeng1 jat1 joeng6 daai6。
text: 呢張枱同我哋屋企嗰張一樣大。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Green suits you very well.

jyutping: luk6 sik1 hou2 can3 nei5。
text: 綠色好襯你。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Could you explain that one more time?

jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gaai2 sik1 do1 ci3 bei2 ngo5 teng1 aa3？
text: 你可唔可以解釋多次俾我聽呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Is it open round the clock?

jyutping: hai6 mai6 jaa6 sei3 siu2 si4 jing4 jip6 gaa3？
text: 係咪廿四小時營業㗎？

english.text: We are going to the movies. Come with us.
We're going to the cinema. Come with us.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tai2 hei3 aa3。jat1 cai4 aa1。
text: 我哋去睇戲呀。一齊吖。

author: richke

english.text: I understand your Cantonese.

jyutping: ngo5 teng1 dak1 ming4 nei5 ge3 gwong2 dung1 waa2。
text: 我聽得明你嘅廣東話。

author: kaenif

english.text: Tom couldn't live up to Mary's expectations.

jyutping: Tom daat6 m4 dou2 Mary ge3 kei4 mong6。
text: Tom達唔到Mary嘅期望。

author: nickyeow

english.text: My mother made me a bag.

jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa1 zing2 zo2 go3 doi6 bei2 ngo5。
text: 我阿媽整咗個袋俾我。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom said there's problem with the TV.

jyutping: aa3 Tom waa6 bou6 din6 si6 gei1 jau5 di1 man6 tai4。
text: 阿Tom話部電視機有啲問題。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you think a little salt would improve the flavor?

jyutping: nei5 waa6 lok6 siu2 siu2 jim4 wui5 m4 wui5 hou2 mei6 di1 aa1 naa4？
text: 你話落少少鹽會唔會好味啲吖嗱？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He is good at dealing with children.

jyutping: keoi5 hou2 sik1 tung4 siu2 pang4 jau5 soeng1 cyu2。
text: 佢好識同小朋友相處。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The seagulls in Helsinki steal ice cream out of people's hands.

jyutping: haak1 ji5 san1 gei1 di1 hoi2 au1 wui5 tau1 jan4 sau2 soeng6 min6 ge3 syut3 gou1 lai4 sik6。
text: 赫爾辛基啲海鷗會偷人手上面嘅雪糕嚟食。

author: nickyeow

english.text: That's not what I meant.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 gam3 ge3 ji3 si1。
text: 我唔係咁嘅意思。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I lol'd.
I laughed.

jyutping: ngo5 siu3 zo2。
text: 我笑咗。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I've been here for three weeks.

jyutping: ngo5 lai4 zo2 ne1 dou3 saam1 go3 lai5 baai3 laa3。
text: 我嚟咗呢到三個禮拜喇。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: If you want it, you can have it.

jyutping: soeng2 jiu3 zau6 bei2 nei5 lo1。
text: 想要就畀你囉。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Be quiet! They're sleeping!

jyutping: syu4！keoi4 dang2 kwan3 gan2 aa1！
text: 殊！渠等睏緊啊！

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tom goes to Australia once a month.

jyutping: aa3 tong1 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 heoi3 jat1 ci3 ou3 zau1。
text: 阿湯每個月都去一次澳州。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Mary said she wasn't angry.

jyutping: maa5 lei6 waa6 zi6 gei2 mou4 niu5。
text: 馬利話自己無嬲。

author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: Rosengren said that because sulforaphane is natural, known to be safe and has no known side effects, he thinks it could be approved as a blood sugar-lowering agent by U.S. and European regulators in the next year or two.

jyutping: Rosengren waa6，jau4 jyu1 wong4 on1 hai6 tin1 jin4 ge3，ji5 ging1 zi1 dou3 hai6 on1 cyun4 ge3，jik6 dou1 mou5 mat1 ji5 zi1 ge3 fu3 zok3 jung6，so2 ji5 keoi5 jing6 wai4 keoi5 ho2 ji5 hai2 mei6 loi4 jat1 loeng5 nin4 noi6 bei2 mei5 gwok3 tung4 au1 zau1 gaam1 gun2 gei1 kau3 pai1 zeon2 wai6 gong3 hyut3 tong4 joek6 mat6。
text: Rosengren 話，由於磺胺係天然嘅，已經知道係安全嘅，亦都冇乜已知嘅副作用，所以佢認為佢可以喺未來一兩年內畀美國同歐洲監管機構批准為降血糖藥物。

author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: Researchers studying a mouse model of diabetes noted that the animals had significantly lower numbers of skeletal stem cells to repair bone fractures. When the bones did finally heal, they were weaker and less dense than those of non-diabetic mice.

jyutping: jin4 gau3 tong4 niu6 beng6 siu2 syu2 mou4 jing4 ge3 jin4 gau3 jan4 jyun4 zi2 ceot1，ni1 di1 dung6 mat6 jung6 lei4 sau1 fuk6 gwat1 zit3 ge3 gwat1 gaak3 gon3 sai3 baau1 sou3 loeng6 ming4 hin2 siu2 zo2，dong1 gwat1 gaak3 zung1 jyu1 jyu6 hap6 go2 zan6，keoi5 dei6 dai1 gwo3 fei1 tong4 niu6 beng6 lou5 syu2 zai2 ge3 gwat1 gaak3 joek6 di1 ge3 mat6 dou6。
text: 研究糖尿病小鼠模型嘅研究人員指出，呢啲動物用嚟修復骨折嘅骨骼幹細胞數量明顯少咗，當骨骼終於癒合嗰陣，佢哋低過非糖尿病老鼠仔嘅骨骼弱啲嘅密度。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Throughout their career the Sixth Men had often been fascinated by the idea of flight. The bird was again and again their most sacred symbol. Their monotheism was apt to be worship not of a god-man, but of a godbird, conceived now as the divine sea-eagle, winged with power, now as the giant swift, winged with mercy, now as a disembodied spirit of air, and once as the bird-god that became man to endow the human race with flight, physical and spiritual.

jyutping: hai2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 zik1 jip6 sang1 ngaai4 jap6 min6，dai6 luk6 jan4 ging1 soeng4 bei6 fei1 hang4 ge3 soeng2 faat3 mai4 zyu6，ne1 zek3 zoek3 jat1 ci3 jau6 jat1 ci3 dei6 sing4 wai4 keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 san4 sing3 ge3 zoeng6 zing1，keoi5 dei6 ge3 jat1 san4 leon6 wong5 wong5 m4 hai6 sung4 baai3 san4，ji4 hai6 sung4 baai3 jat1 zek3 san4 niu5，ji4 gaa1 bei6 kau3 soeng2 wai4 san4 sing3 ge3 hoi2 jing1，jau5 lik6 loeng6 ge3 ci3 pong4，ji4 gaa1 hai6 geoi6 jan4 ge3 seon3 zit6，jau5 ci4 bei1 ge3 ci3 pong4，ji4 gaa1 hai6 jau5 ci4 bei1 ge3 zing1 san4 fu3 jyu5 jan4 leoi6 fei1 hang4，san1 tai2 tung4 zing1 san4。
text: 喺佢哋嘅職業生涯入面，第六人經常被飛行嘅想法迷住，呢隻雀一次又一次地成為佢哋最神聖嘅象徵，佢哋嘅一神論往往唔係崇拜神，而係崇拜一隻神鳥，而家被構想為神聖嘅海鷹，有力量嘅翅膀，而家係巨人嘅迅捷，有慈悲嘅翅膀，而家係有慈悲嘅精神賦予人類飛行，身體同精神。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Before I even arrive at the Oval Office, shortly after we all together win the presidency, we will have the horrible war between Russia and Ukraine settled. It will be settled. The war is going to be settled. I'll get them both—I know Zelensky, I know Putin, it'll be done within 24 hours, you watch. They all say, "That’s such a boast." It will be done very quickly.

jyutping: ngo5 zung6 mei6 heoi3 dou3 to5 jyun4 baan6 gung1 sat1，hai2 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 jeng4 zo2 zung2 tung2 zik1 wai6 zi1 hau6，ngo5 dei6 zau6 wui5 gaai2 kyut3 zo2 ngo4 lo4 si1 tung4 wu1 hak1 laan4 zi1 gaan1 ge3 ho2 paa3 zin3 zang1。wui5 gaai2 kyut3。zin3 zang1 zoeng1 wui5 gaai2 kyut3。ngo5 wui5 lo2 dou2 keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 — ngo5 sik1 zaak6 leon4 si1 gei1，ngo5 sik1 pou2 ging1，ni1 gin6 si6 wui5 hai2 24 go3 zung1 noi6 jyun4 sing4，nei5 tai2 zyu6。keoi5 dei6 dou1 waa6：「ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 gam2 ge3 ceoi1 heoi1。」wui5 hou2 faai3 jyun4 sing4。
text: 我仲未去到橢圓辦公室，喺我哋一齊贏咗總統職位之後，我哋就會解決咗俄羅斯同烏克蘭之間嘅可怕戰爭。會解決。戰爭將會解決。我會攞到佢哋兩個 — 我識澤倫斯基，我識普京，呢件事會喺24個鐘內完成，你睇住。佢哋都話：「呢個係一個噉嘅吹噓。」會好快完成。
